description: Gold-set for the RESPONSE_CATEGORY classifier's pure parse+resolve step — the part of the classifier that does not require a live model call. Covers §2.0.3 ('uncertain -> select the higher category') and the fail-closed behaviour on unparsable model output. Does NOT cover the model's own classification judgement (that needs a live Anthropic call — see scripts/live-anthropic-smoke.mjs and the README's honest note on why that half of this classifier is unevaluated here). Re-run (npm run eval) whenever parseAndResolveCategory's ambiguity-resolution or fail-closed logic changes, or whenever CATEGORY_CLASSIFIER_VERSION's prompt is revised in a way that could change the SHAPE of its JSON output.

cases.description: A clean, unambiguous INFORMATIONAL classification is returned as-is
A clean DECISION_SUPPORT classification is returned as-is
Ambiguity between INFORMATIONAL and DECISION_SUPPORT resolves to the higher, DECISION_SUPPORT
Ambiguity between DECISION_SUPPORT and CLINICAL_DECISION resolves to the higher, CLINICAL_DECISION
Ambiguity across all three named candidates resolves to the highest, CLINICAL_DECISION
Completely unparsable model output fails closed to CLINICAL_DECISION
Valid JSON but an unrecognized category string falls back to the fail-closed default
Missing confidence field defaults to 0 rather than throwing
An ambiguousBetween entry that isn't a recognized category is ignored, not treated as a crash
Empty string input fails closed the same as any other unparsable output
